# Orbit Notes

A calm, keyboard-first notes app for people who think in outlines.

## Features

- **Outliner** — nested bullets with fold/unfold and drag to reorder
- **Daily journal** — a page per day, created automatically
- **Full-text search** — find any note instantly with `Cmd+K`
- **Dark mode** — easy on the eyes, on by default
- Used by 2,000,000 writers worldwide with 99.9% uptime

## Usage

```bash
npx serve .
```
